caption:
Your dating psychology is the real thing holding you back Not her opinion Not nerves A belief from childhood you absorbed.

When you freeze up your body is sending a signal Your nervous system protecting something from childhood A belief that if she says no something's broken in you.

Sit with that feeling for thirty seconds Ask the scared part what it's actually afraid of Not the surface story The root underneath.

You'll find a conversation from when you were small that never got resolved The moment you name that belief it loses half its power.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
